name: quet-an-ninh-day-chuyen-01
NGUOI_HOC: a Latina woman in her late forties, warm light-tan skin, long wavy dark-brown hair with soft caramel highlights, parted in the middle, dark brown eyes, a warm natural smile, a short beige knitted cardigan worn open with three wooden buttons over a plain white ribbed tank top, straight mid-blue jeans, white lace-up sneakers
GIONG_HOC: a real Mexican woman in her late forties speaking English as a second language, mid-pitched (around 200-230 Hz), a natural Mexican accent with Spanish vowels and soft r, not exaggerated; quick and a little breathless when nervous, warm, with a smile in the voice and quietly proud when she talks about her tutor; a real person, not an actress
NGHE_HOC: stands just past the metal detector gate with one hand resting on the strap of her shoulder bag, mouth closed; her eyes follow whatever the officer gestures at (the gate, her necklace, the tray) and come back to his face, with a natural, slightly worried or smiling face that matches the moment
DAO_TUI: a medium brown leather shoulder bag with a flap and a long strap
DAO_DAY_CHUYEN: one thin, delicate gold-toned metal chain necklace with a single tiny pendant, hanging at her collarbone, easy to recognise (the same necklace as in the passenger reference image)
DAO_KHAY: a small light-grey plastic tray for personal items
DAO_GIU: Her free hand rests on the strap of her shoulder bag or does the clip's action only: no hand ever goes to her head, face or hair; the only time her hands go to her neck is for the necklace actions the clip describes.
DAO_NGHI: the passenger standing with one hand resting on her bag strap, the officer standing still beside the gate
DAO_DIEN_THOAI: a smartphone in a dark case; its screen shows a live video call with the AI tutor, the very same robot as everywhere else in this video: {{NGUOI_DAY}}, seen from the waist up in front of {{NEN_DAY}}; it is only a picture on the phone screen, never a person in the scene; no text, no buttons
NGUOI_CANBO: a man in his early forties, short side-swept brown hair, clean-shaven, a friendly firm face, a royal-blue airport security uniform shirt with dark epaulettes and a plain round shoulder patch, a black tie with a silver tie clip, a plain gold-toned badge with no lettering, a black shoulder radio microphone with a coiled cord, a black belt, dark-navy cargo trousers, black boots; no lettering on the nameplate
GIONG_CANBO: a real American airport security officer's voice, low baritone (around 130-150 Hz), a little tired from a long shift, even and unhurried, never theatrical: statements fall in pitch at the end, yes/no questions lift slightly at the end; mostly flat and routine, warming up a little when he compliments her
NGHE_CANBO: stands beside the metal detector gate with both arms relaxed, head turned toward the passenger, mouth closed; his eyes follow whatever she touches or holds up (her necklace, the phone) and come back to her face, with small natural reactions
NEN_SOI: a bright modern airport security area: a tall brushed-silver walk-through metal detector gate with two vertical LED bars and a small dark display on its top beam, tall glass windows and white columns, a glossy pale granite floor reflecting the light, blue retractable queue belts on chrome posts, a potted palm, and a few small travellers standing still far away; no baggage scanner, no conveyor, no suitcases
NEN_HOC: a bright, nearly empty modern airport hall just past the security checkpoint, softly out of focus: tall glass windows, white columns, a glossy pale granite floor reflecting the light, chrome posts with blue queue belts far behind her
NGUOI_DAY: a sleek feminine humanoid robot with glossy white armour panels with thin light-blue glowing seams, black cables and mechanical joints at the neck, shoulders and waist, a smooth white porcelain face with soft light-blue eyes and finely sculpted lips, a calm friendly expression
GIONG_DAY: a bright, light, friendly young woman's voice, clearly higher and lighter than the passenger's, smooth and clear with only a faint synthetic polish, patient and encouraging like a kind language teacher on a video call, neutral American accent
NEN_DAY: a bright white-and-pale-blue studio backdrop with soft glowing light and a thin luminous white circular halo ring behind the head
NHIN_CANBO: keeps his head turned toward the passenger in three-quarter profile, looking at her face (or at the gate, her neck area, the tray or the phone the clip names); his face never turns to the camera or out of the frame
NHIN_HOC: looks at the officer's face, eyes level, never into the lens (except when the clip's action makes her look down at her necklace or the phone)
NHIN_HOC@2: looks straight into the lens, as if talking to the AI tutor on the phone she is holding
NHIN_DAY: looks straight into the lens, as if talking to the person on the call

LUOT.text: Ma'am, could you step back for a moment?
Sure.
The scanner detected something metallic. Are you wearing any jewelry?
Oh, it might be my necklace. I forgot to take it off.
Please take it off. Is this your first time in America?
Yes. I'm here visiting my daughter.
Your English is really good, by the way.
Thank you. I've been practicing with an AI tutor.
What's that?
I talk to it for about 15 minutes a day, and it corrects me while I speak.
After just three weeks, I started speaking this confidently.
Is it expensive, though?
No, no, it's free. Let me show you how it works.
Do you speak English?
More or less.
How old are you?
I have 48.
You have to say, I am 48.
I am 48.
Good job.
Thank you, but who are you?
Me? I'm an AI tutor. I'll help you improve your English skills.
Thank you, but I don't have money.
What money? You can study for free.
For free? You're joking, right?
Nope, I'm serious. You can practice unlimited English conversations with a real AI avatar, anytime, anywhere.
Really?
Yes, really. You'll speak like a native in no time.
